title: Real-money ETH 4h package got a 0.26R TP (donchian_measured_move anchored pre-breakout on a forming entry bar)
note: Root cause: tp_revision donchian_measured_move anchors on the last closed bar when the entry bar is still forming (entry_bar_closed=false); fix = no closed entry bar => could-not-look. Closes when merged+deployed and next forming-bar ETH 4h entry keeps its resting TP. roadmap L-OPS. Its 12 sibling mirror closes since 10-15 all resolved (exchange_fill / local_compute). CLOSES: 6787 pnl non-null with exit_price_source exchange_fill; if still NULL at 2026-10-30T02:50Z (close+6h+grace) it is a real bug -> reopen.
